summary.description: Finds communities in the reviewed graph and keeps those that contain main people.
summary.input: the reviewed graph
summary.output: ordered circles with members and ties

summary.description: Collects the localized names of the story’s people from their translated person data and looks up map places in Wikipedia language links.
summary.input: the composed meta story and localized person data
summary.output: name evidence for people and places

summary.description: Selects the people who fit the theme and writes the story’s title, introduction, subtopics, chapters, and conclusion. Names people missing from the registry.
summary.input: the person registry and life events
summary.output: a story plan and selected people

summary.description: Filters the selected people’s life events to major contributions relevant to the theme and records why each is relevant.
summary.input: the selected people and life events

summary.description: Adds to each chapter a few dated historical events that directly affected its people.
summary.input: the chapters and their events

summary.description: Combines the selected people’s ego networks into one social graph by matching names. It keeps direct ties and acquaintances shared by several main people.
summary.input: selected people and ego networks

summary.description: Reviews the merged network against the article evidence, adding missed direct ties and removing vague or indirect ones.
summary.input: the merged network

summary.description: Writes a factual title and short text about the ties of each circle.
summary.input: the circles to narrate
summary.output: a title and text per circle

summary.description: Groups rated events into nearby places, keeps the highest-scoring places, and orders them in time.
summary.input: located events and per-event weights

summary.description: Rates each located event by how relevant its place is to the story’s theme. The ratings weight the place clustering.
summary.input: the chapters and life events

summary.description: Writes a short factual title and text for each geographic cluster and discards the clusters that are not relevant to the story.
summary.input: the geographic clusters
summary.output: map stops with titles and texts

summary.description: Rewrites the circle, timeline, and map texts as one story in a consistent style, sets their order, and removes map stops that do not fit the story.
summary.input: circle narration, map stops, and background material

summary.description: Derives a dark color, type, pattern, and ornament system for the story from its framing and opening.
summary.input: the story’s framing and opening

summary.description: Translates the meta story, taking person names and event titles from the localized person data.
summary.input: the meta story and localized person data

summary.description: Writes a background report for each deep event whose sources hold material about the event itself, and sets its citations.
summary.input: the reviewed events and source articles

summary.description: Draws one abstract image for each chapter from its concept, in the portrait style and the story’s colors.
summary.input: chapter concepts, story colors, and style

summary.description: Develops an abstract visual concept for each chapter from the life events.
summary.input: the finished life events
summary.output: an abstract visual concept per chapter

summary.description: Selects the most significant events of the life, weighs them against each other, and groups them into chapters. Leaves dated event skeletons and a conclusion.
summary.input: the article and selected related articles
summary.output: a chaptered life timeline and conclusion

summary.description: Researches each proposed event in the subject’s article and related articles and writes its description, places, people, sources, and image searches.
summary.input: an event skeleton and Wikipedia material

summary.description: Adds map coordinates to the places in the life events.
summary.input: historic and modern place names

summary.description: Decides the target-language form of each person name and writes one glossary shared by the life events, network, and registry.
summary.input: name evidence and person names

summary.description: Checks Commons results against each report and keeps only pictures that directly depict things the report names.
summary.input: the report, its searches, and life events

summary.description: Runs the planned searches and each event’s own searches against Commons and Openverse and keeps one candidate per picture.
summary.input: the planned and event image searches

summary.description: Scores and ranks the image hits and drops those below a threshold. Commemorative images such as plaques and graves are penalized.
summary.input: the image hits

summary.description: Picks a reference portrait and assigns images to the life events they directly depict.
summary.input: the ranked image candidates

summary.description: Plans Commons searches for the portrait and for things the events name, excluding commemorative objects.
summary.input: the event skeletons

summary.description: Checks the chosen portrait against the person by inspecting the image and removes it if rejected.
summary.input: the portrait pick

summary.description: Fetches the person’s article in the target language and the target-language names of the people and places in the data.
summary.input: reviewed names, life events, and ego network

summary.description: Builds the subject’s network of direct ties to named people from the life events and Wikipedia material.
summary.input: finished life events and Wikipedia material

summary.description: Redraws the person’s reference portrait in the shared drawing style and the story’s colors.
summary.input: the person registry and interface style
summary.output: a portrait and updated person registry

summary.description: Reviews the life events and ego network together against the source articles and proposes corrections and prose revisions. Only changes the critic rates with high confidence are applied.
summary.input: the life events, network, and source articles
summary.output: reviewed life events and ego network

summary.description: Derives a dark color, type, and pattern system from the person’s work, places, and pictured objects.
summary.input: the finished life events and image captions
summary.output: a palette, type system, and pattern

summary.description: Translates the person’s events, network, registry entry, and reports, applying the name glossary. Dates, coordinates, links, and identifiers are kept from the English record.
summary.input: the person record, reports, and name mapping

summary.description: Fetches the subject article, candidate related articles, and Commons image metadata and caches them.
summary.input: a subject or article URL

summary.description: Ranks the linked articles by relevance to the life story and keeps those about people, personal events, and individual works.
summary.input: the article and outgoing link candidates
